summary: Layer 3 second pass over the leftover candidates of chapters 19 to 30, plus two chapter 13 candidates surfaced by an earlier reviewer (late firing). 37 records added: chapter 13 c13-31 (1), chapter 19 c19-15 to c19-22 (8), chapter 20 c20-13 to c20-16 (4), chapter 21 c21-16 to c21-24 (9), chapter 22 c22-19 and c22-21 to c22-27 (8; the draft c22-20 on a supermajority tax vote was dropped in review as covered by c22-01 and its id is left unused), chapter 26 c26-20 to c26-23 (4), chapter 27 c27-18 to c27-20 (3). Chapters 23, 24, 25, 28, 29 and 30 yielded no new record: their leftovers are internal practices, dissenting views or items already within existing records. Every record was independently reviewed and scored blind by two raters; c19-20 went to a third rater. Review lowered or re-staged seven drafts (c19-22 moved from not_started to diverged because FRA defended its 2024 crew-size rule in court; c20-15, c27-19 and c27-20 moved from in_progress to proposed; c21-18 and c21-21 lowered within in_progress; c21-22 moved to proposed; c22-23 moved to not_started) and raised two (c21-16, c22-21). Reverse cross-references were added on 36 existing records. The counted set is now 627. With this firing the second pass of the enumeration is complete: every chapter's leftover candidates have been researched or set aside with a reason recorded in the backlog. About 99 of 190 searches used (researchers 88, reviewers 11, raters 0). With the enumeration complete, the same firing began the primary-source lift (backlog task B16) on 24 medium-confidence records chosen by significance weight: the stage-deciding documents were read and each record was independently reviewed; no stage changed, confidence rose on 14 records and fell on one (c12-11, 72 to 64, because its stage rests on the absence of a directive), and three moved to high (c03-02, c03-03, c11-15). court_status was changed on c05-06 (upheld, after the Supreme Court's 2026-10-05 order) and set on c06-10 (stayed) and c11-02 (stayed). About 115 of 190 searches used in all.
title: Fuller enumeration, second pass: chapters 19 to 30 and chapter 13 leftovers (37 records added; second pass complete)
